name: Vita Coco 100% Pure Coconut Water
whyItWorks: The clear liquid from young green coconuts is naturally packed with potassium, sodium, and magnesium—replenishing vital intracellular electrolytes lost to acute diarrhea. Contains 0g fiber and 0g fat.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drink chilled in 8-oz glasses between meals. Do not confuse with high-fat coconut milk or shredded coconut meat.
watchOuts: Drink slowly; drinking large volumes quickly can have a mild laxative effect due to natural potassium.
